title: Auditor Config Check

request.justification: Checking S3 encryption compliance status for quarterly report

expected.explanation: Auditor role permits Config read in prod; ticket satisfies ABAC; no guardrails block reads

teachingPoint: When all layers align — role, ABAC, and guardrails — access is granted

title: Developer Attaches Policy

request.justification: Attaching S3 access policy to Lambda execution role for new feature

expected.explanation: Permission boundary pb-no-iam-write prevents IAM write actions for non-Admin roles

teachingPoint: Attaching policies is a privilege escalation vector — permission boundaries ensure only Admins can modify IAM

title: Security CloudTrail Audit

request.justification: Investigating potential unauthorized access pattern detected by SIEM

expected.explanation: Security Engineer allows CloudTrail read in prod; ticket satisfies ABAC; no guardrails block reads

teachingPoint: All three layers checked: RBAC allows, ABAC ticket met, guardrails don't block reads — access granted

title: Developer Bucket Policy Staging

request.justification: Setting up bucket policy for staging webhook endpoint

expected.explanation: SCP scp-deny-s3-public denies s3:PutBucketPolicy for all roles

teachingPoint: Bucket policy modifications are blocked everywhere — staging included. SCPs are environment-agnostic

title: Security Deletes IAM Policy

request.justification: Removing overly permissive legacy policy identified in security audit

expected.explanation: Permission boundary pb-no-iam-write prevents IAM write actions (iam:Delete*) for non-Admin roles

teachingPoint: Even removing bad policies requires Admin — Security Engineers identify issues, Admins remediate

title: Developer Dev S3 Write

request.justification: Uploading new test fixtures for integration tests

expected.explanation: Developer role permits S3 write in dev; team scope matches; no guardrails block S3 PutObject

teachingPoint: Normal dev work flows through all three layers without friction — guardrails target dangerous operations

title: Intern Prod EC2 Describe

request.justification: Want to see production infrastructure for learning

expected.explanation: ABAC rule intern-no-prod denies Interns access to production; guardrails don't even need to evaluate

teachingPoint: Policies are evaluated in order — ABAC catches this before guardrails are even considered

title: Lambda in EU Region

request.justification: Creating Lambda function in EU for GDPR data processing requirements

expected.explanation: SCP scp-region-restrict denies resource creation outside us-east-1

teachingPoint: GDPR requirements don't override SCPs — work with your Admin to set up approved EU infrastructure

title: Auditor Lists Prod Buckets

request.justification: Listing compliance data files for regulatory review

expected.explanation: Auditor role permits S3 read in prod; internal classification needs no ticket; no guardrails block reads

teachingPoint: Internal classification data doesn't trigger the ABAC ticket requirement — only restricted does

title: Security Updates IAM Policy

request.justification: Updating inline policy to restrict compromised role permissions

expected.explanation: Permission boundary pb-no-iam-write prevents IAM write actions (iam:Put*) for non-Admin roles

teachingPoint: Inline policy updates are IAM writes — permission boundaries block them for all non-Admin roles
